track.title: Track Loan Application Lifecycle
track.subtitle: Transparent, audit-logged tracking from initial inquiry to final concessional disbursal. Look up your application using your unique SETU-XXXX-XXXX reference.
track.searchPlaceholder: Enter Reference ID (e.g. SETU-DEMO-2026 or SETU-XXXX-XXXX)

track.disclaimerP2: Scheme Setu does not process or guarantee loan approvals. Statutory credit appraisal, loan sanction, and fund disbursement remain strictly within the statutory jurisdiction of the respective empanelled Channel Partner (State SC Corporation or Bank).
